- Read the active bug task: it requires a strict two-state DCS authority model with no stale cluster visibility outside authoritative quorum.
- The task file has no NOW EXECUTE marker, so this turn is the type-design pass. I am searching for the relevant DCS/HA authority, cluster-view, and fail-safe types plus the tests that currently encode the wrong behavior.
- Need to identify all overlapping state structs/enums before editing so the type refactor happens in one coherent pass.

- Mapped the current wrong shape: DCS still exposes NotTrusted/Degraded/Quorum, and HA publication plus CLI/tests still treat degraded non-authoritative visibility as a first-class state.
- The stricter redesign needs to delete non-authoritative DCS payloads entirely and make quorum-vs-no-quorum explicit in the HA coordination ADT, so downstream code cannot accidentally consume members/switchover/leadership outside quorum.
- Next I am editing the core DCS and HA type definitions plus the task file plan, intentionally without fixing compile errors in this turn.

- Mapped the current DCS/HA authority-state tree for bug-dcs-must-never-report-stale-cluster-data-outside-authoritative-quorum.
- Canonical DCS state is still a three-state ADT in src/dcs/state.rs: DcsAuthority::{NotTrusted,Degraded,Quorum} and DcsSnapshot::{NotTrusted{observed_leadership},Degraded(DcsObservedCluster),Quorum(DcsQuorumState)}. Non-quorum states still expose observed_leadership plus members via snapshot accessors.
- HA observation in src/ha/worker.rs still consumes stale DCS data outside quorum: local_member_identity_fallback uses dcs.member(self), build_storage_state uses dcs.member(self), build_global_knowledge builds peers and observed primary from dcs.members(), resolve_replica_upstream uses dcs.members(), and build_leadership_view uses dcs.observed_leadership() plus dcs.member(holder). HA decision/publication types in src/ha/types.rs preserve old semantics through NoPrimaryProjection::{DcsDegraded,StaleObservedLease} and LeadershipView::StaleObservedLease; src/ha/decide.rs branches on !is_quorum and publishes those variants.
- Operator-facing stale-member exposure remains in src/command/mod.rs, src/cli/status.rs, src/cli/connect.rs, and src/cli/switchover.rs because NodeState carries raw DcsSnapshot and those modules still render/lookup state.dcs.members(), member_count(), member(), mode_label(), and switchover().
- Old-behavior tests/features found: src/ha/reconcile.rs test degraded_failsafe_keeps_stale_lease_instead_of_releasing_it; src/ha/decide.rs test stale_observed_lease_does_not_block_failover_candidacy; src/ha/worker.rs test basebackup_awaiting_restart_ignores_stale_dcs_local_identity; tests/ha/support/steps/mod.rs step the_cluster_is_degraded_but_operational_across_two_running_nodes and visibility helpers; features ha_two_replicas_stopped_then_one_replica_restarted_restores_quorum and ha_two_nodes_stopped_then_one_healthy_node_restarted_restores_service_while_other_stays_broken assert degraded-but-visible two-node service.
- Minimal redesign pass likely needs src/dcs/state.rs, src/ha/types.rs, src/ha/worker.rs, src/ha/decide.rs, plus the outward render/lookup surfaces src/command/mod.rs src/cli/status.rs src/cli/connect.rs src/cli/switchover.rs and the HA harness observer/steps/world files that currently rank or assert visible members during non-quorum.

- Completed the design-only pass for the stale-DCS bug and intentionally stopped before execution.
- Changed DCS types to the strict two-state model (`NoQuorum | Quorum(DcsQuorumState)`), removed the non-authoritative observed-cluster payload, and changed `current_snapshot` so quorum loss cannot publish members or leadership at the DCS boundary.
- Reshaped HA coordination types around `CoordinationState::NoQuorum | Quorum(QuorumCoordinationState)`, removed top-level `switchover`/`peers` from `GlobalKnowledge`, replaced `NoPrimaryProjection::DcsDegraded` with `NoPrimaryProjection::NoQuorum`, and removed the leftover `StaleLeaseReason` type so stale-observed lease cannot be modeled.
- Updated the active bug task file with research notes, the finished type-design summary, execution steps, constraints, and appended `NOW EXECUTE`.
- Did not run make targets or attempt compile fixes; the tree is intentionally broken for the next execution pass. Next step is to execute the plan starting in src/ha/worker.rs, src/ha/decide.rs, src/ha/reconcile.rs, then API/CLI and HA harness/tests.

- Read the previous progress log and confirmed the active task pointer is .ralph/tasks/bugs/bug-dcs-must-never-report-stale-cluster-data-outside-authoritative-quorum.md.
- Previous pass already completed the design-only ADT refactor and updated the task with NOW EXECUTE; I am now reading the task body and checking the worktree before execution.
- Next step is to inspect the task instructions and current compile failures, then execute the plan without regressing the two-state authority design.

- Started the execution pass by threading the new two-state authority ADT through core HA code.
- Patched src/ha/types.rs with quorum accessors, rewrote src/ha/worker.rs to only build peers/switchover/leadership/observed primary inside CoordinationState::Quorum, rewrote src/ha/decide.rs to use NoQuorum vs Quorum and publish NoPrimaryProjection::NoQuorum, updated src/ha/reconcile.rs switchover/leadership access, and changed src/process/worker.rs to use dcs.quorum_state() instead of the removed coordinated() helper.
- Next step is to re-run make check, fix the remaining compile errors, and then rewrite the stale-behavior tests and operator surfaces that still assume global peers/switchover or stale lease visibility.

- make check now reaches lib-test compilation; remaining breaks are mainly stale HA unit tests that still construct the old CoordinationState struct shape and stale-leased projections.
- Rewrote decide/reconcile test builders to construct CoordinationState::Quorum(QuorumCoordinationState), replaced the stale-observed-lease test with an explicit NoQuorum fail-safe assertion, and fixed the worker test import for SwitchoverState.
- Next step is to finish removing the last old-shape test mutations, rerun make check, then move on to CLI/API/test-harness behavior that still assumes non-authoritative member visibility.

- make lint reached clippy and exposed a real structural follow-up: CoordinationState::Quorum is too large for the repo's no-warning policy.
- The fix is to box QuorumCoordinationState inside CoordinationState while keeping the two-state ADT and all semantics unchanged.
- Next step is to patch the enum and all construction/match helpers, rerun make lint, then continue into make test / make test-long and docs.

- Long-test investigation showed the regression came from src/dcs/worker.rs, not the HA ADTs: a transient self-held lease keepalive expiry tore down the entire DCS session, published NoQuorum, and triggered unnecessary demotion/failover.
- Fixed that by introducing a dedicated LeaderLeaseExpired path that drops only the local leadership lease, reloads the authoritative DCS snapshot, and keeps the etcd session connected so quorum can continue with an open lease instead of forcing fail-safe.
- Required gates after the fix: make check passed again, make lint passed again, make test passed again, the four previously failing ultra-long scenarios passed in a focused rerun, and the final full make test-long rerun is still in progress but already past the previously failing early scenarios.

- Re-validated the current execution-pass tree after the last HA harness patch.
- make check passed cleanly, so the new helper in tests/ha/support/steps/mod.rs compiles and the remaining issue is behavioral, not a broken build.
- Next step is a focused make test-long run for ha_dcs_and_api_faults_then_healed_cluster_converges, then a full make test-long if that focused rerun is green.

- Focused make test-long for ha_dcs_and_api_faults_then_healed_cluster_converges passed after rewriting the step helper to poll authoritative state and routed primary in one loop.
- That strongly suggests the last red run was a harness-level observer race rather than another product regression.
- Next step is to rerun the remaining required gates on the final tree (make lint, make test, then full make test-long) before docs and task completion.

- Re-ran the final-tree gates that changed after the last harness patch: make test passed and make lint passed.
- The focused ultra-long recovery scenario also passed, so the only remaining validation gate is a full make test-long run on the current revision.
- If full make test-long is green, next step is docs refresh with k2-docs-loop and then the Ralph task completion flow.

- Full make test-long failed once in ha_dcs_quorum_lost_fencing_blocks_post_cutoff_writes, but the failure was a late proof-row convergence timeout with direct SQL connection refused on node-b rather than an assertion mismatch.
- Re-ran that scenario in isolation and it passed, which strongly suggests a non-deterministic HA/harness timing issue rather than a reproducible product regression on the current tree.
- Next step is to rerun the full make test-long suite; if it flakes again on the same helper path, harden the shared proof-row convergence step before attempting final completion.

- Re-ran the full make test-long suite after the one isolated flake and it passed cleanly.
- That means the required validation gates are now green on the current revision: make check, make lint, make test, and make test-long.
- Next step is the required docs update pass via the k2-docs-loop skill, then mark the task passed, switch task, commit, and push.

- Finished the docs pass after validation by updating the DCS state reference, trust-model explanation, and HA state reference to match the new two-state quorum/no-quorum authority model.
- Re-ran make lint after the docs edits; it passed after changing fenced code blocks in the reference page from rust to text to satisfy docs policy.
- Marked the active bug task as done with passes=true; next step is the required Ralph task switch, then stage everything, commit with validation evidence in the message, and push.
